svg.title: Opening root ambiguity: target and excluded control
svg.desc: Public boards before lock three. Left: uncapped floor with geometric partner-completion support, showing checked I-left landing. Right: an already capped unrecognized Center, excluded from the extension, showing the unchanged S-left landing. Dashed cells are legal replayed first-lock targets, not imported board occupancy.
svg.text: One narrow opening family, not generic depth four
Exact public roots before lock 3. Board rows 33–40 are shown.
Preview: O S J J S L

Preview: J T O L J O
The original S-left recommendation is unchanged.
Solid cells: observed board. Dashed + cells: actual replayed first-lock target.
This is finite construction advice, not a completed opening or a >99% reliability claim.
